trend.description: Draw a small history line under the reading over this window.

range.description: Show the reading against its field's declared range. Only fields with a range accept it.

field.description: Select any State field by JSON Pointer; omit for the root. Numeric fields show a reading with its unit; yes/no and text fields show words. hearth.binarysensor/v1: "" (root); hearth.brightness/v1: "" (root); hearth.colorhs/v1: /active, /hue, /saturation; hearth.colormode/v1: "" (root); hearth.colortemp/v1: /active, /value; hearth.colorxy/v1: /active, /x, /y; hearth.enumsetting/v1: "" (root); hearth.numericsensor/v1: "" (root); hearth.numericsetting/v1: /choice, /mode, /value; hearth.power/v1: "" (root); hearth.pressure/v1: "" (root); hearth.relativehumidity/v1: "" (root); hearth.speed/v1: "" (root); hearth.temperature/v1: "" (root).

style.description: lanes: one shared time axis for comparing rows. ledger: each row's current value and totals above a strip. feed: a merged list of changes, newest first.

source.description: A yes/no State field. Text fields are rejected.
Explicit numeric State source from the power Entity's Device. The reading and sparkline share this source; never choose by name or list order at render time.

detail.description: Optional additional numeric reading from the same Device, such as its total-energy counter. Display the reading, not an integration of the sparkline.

metric.description: Metering variant: the selected numeric reading and a gap-preserving history line. Omit for an ordinary On/Off tile.

all_off.description: Offer native Turn all off for supported, enabled power Entities. One user gesture requests separate Commands; it is not an atomic group operation.

temperature.description: Outdoor temperature. The card also reads its last 24 hours for the high and low.

wind.description: Sustained wind speed, for a row and wind words.

wind_direction.description: Wind direction in deg, named on the wind row.

rain_rate.description: Rain rate in mm/h, for rain words such as Light rain.

rain_today.description: The station's daily rain total in mm.

rate.description: Rain rate in mm/h: Rain or Dry, and the trend's source.

storm.description: The station's storm (event) rain total in mm. It leads the card while above zero.

day.description: A hearth.numericsensor/v1 Entity whose unit is mm.

week.description: A hearth.numericsensor/v1 Entity whose unit is mm.

month.description: A hearth.numericsensor/v1 Entity whose unit is mm.

year.description: A hearth.numericsensor/v1 Entity whose unit is mm.

totals.description: The station's own rain counters in mm, shown in this order. Never sum the rate.

trend.description: Draw the rain rate over this window.

speed.description: Sustained wind speed: the reading and its Beaufort words.

direction.description: Wind direction in deg: where the wind comes from, drawn on a compass.

trend.description: Draw sustained wind-speed history over this window; direction stays current-only.

source.description: Barometric pressure. The card also reads its last 6 hours for the three-hour tendency.

trend.description: Draw a history line under the reading over this window.

source.description: An hourly forecast Entity. The card charts its upcoming hours.
A daily forecast Entity. The card lists its upcoming days.

NumericField.description: Select a numeric State field by JSON Pointer; omit for the root. hearth.brightness/v1: "" (root) (%; has a range); hearth.colorhs/v1: /hue (deg), /saturation (%; has a range); hearth.colortemp/v1: /value (/MK; has a range); hearth.colorxy/v1: /x (10*-4), /y (10*-4); hearth.numericsensor/v1: "" (root) (Entity support unit; has a range); hearth.numericsetting/v1: /value (Entity support unit; may be absent, mixed chart buckets are gaps; has a range); hearth.pressure/v1: "" (root) (hPa); hearth.relativehumidity/v1: "" (root) (%; has a range); hearth.speed/v1: "" (root) (m/s); hearth.temperature/v1: "" (root) (mCel). Charts use arithmetic sample summaries, not time-weighted or circular means.

field.description: Select a yes/no or text State field by JSON Pointer; omit for the root. hearth.binarysensor/v1: "" (root) (yes/no); hearth.colorhs/v1: /active (yes/no); hearth.colormode/v1: "" (root) (one of xy, hs, color_temp); hearth.colortemp/v1: /active (yes/no); hearth.colorxy/v1: /active (yes/no); hearth.enumsetting/v1: "" (root) (text); hearth.numericsetting/v1: /choice (text), /mode (one of value, choice); hearth.power/v1: "" (root) (yes/no).

BooleanWords.description: Words for a yes/no field's true and false values, such as Open and Closed for a door contact. Only yes/no fields accept words.
